reconcileDrift: The crash coordinator and persistence contracts are accepted, but neither production graph applies them and persisted theme is not connected to AppTheme. Reminder settings contracts are now corrected and will be preserved.
goal: Apply persisted crash collection preferences live on Android/iOS with visible effective state, and propagate persisted SYSTEM/LIGHT/DARK through retained Compose UI with immediate updates.
acceptanceCriteria: Production startup synchronously applies the stored crash preference; later changes disable and re-enable collection without restart, while debug/preview/test remain disabled.
Settings exposes requested and effective Active, User off, Build disabled or Unavailable crash state without user data diagnostics.
Android uses the optional Firebase-free driver and iOS uses the minimal native bridge without requiring external secrets.
EN/RU resources and nonvisual tests cover runtime state. Specialist does not run Gradle.
